Job Title: Application and Web Developer (For Embedded Systems)

Qualification: MCA (Master of Computer Applications)

Experience: 3–4 Years

Location: Gurugram



Job Summary:

We are looking for a skilled Application and Web Developer with strong expertise in front-end and web technologies to design, develop, and maintain dynamic web applications. The ideal candidate should possess hands-on experience in HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, JavaScript, and jQuery and C#, along with good understanding of web frameworks and responsive design principles.



Key Responsibilities:

Design, develop, and maintain responsive and user-friendly web pages and applications for embedded systems.Design UI/UX and convert these to functional web interfaces using HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, and JavaScript/jQuery.Integrate front-end designs with back-end systems or APIs.Develop reusable code and libraries for future use to improve site performance.Ensure cross-browser compatibility and optimize applications for maximum speed and scalability.Collaborate with designers, developers, and IT teams to enhance user experience and new functionality.Troubleshoot, debug, upgrade and maintain existing applications and web modules.Maintain proper documentation for all development work.

Required Skills and Competencies:

Proficient in HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, JavaScript,jQuery, C#.Familiarity with web frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, or similar) is a plus.Basic knowledge of server-side technologies (PHP, ASP.NET, or Node.js preferred) and experience with integration with embedded systems.Knowledge of database technologies such as MySQL, MS SQL, or MongoDBUnderstanding of RESTful APIs, AJAX, XML and JSON.Experience in responsive design and mobile-first development.Good problem-solving skills and attention to detail.Ability to work independently and in a team-oriented environment.

Preferred Skills (Optional):

.Familiarity with version control systems (Git, GitHub, Bitbucket).Exposure to CMS platforms like WordPress or Joomla.Knlwledge and experience with Cmdlets , Perl and Python etc.
